# Miauterm 0.1.5-coral

## Summary

This release migrates the Android package identity to `salu.Kandoraq.Miauterm`, rebrands the remaining upstream identifiers to Miauterm, and fixes ten verified bugs from the 2026-11 audit. The unit-test, lint, and arm64 APK builds pass in CI.

## Changes

### Package and namespace

- Android `applicationId` changed to `salu.Kandoraq.Miauterm`.
- Kotlin namespace changed to `salu.Kandoraq.Miauterm`; source lives under `mdr/Kandoraq/miauterm/`.
- Native library renamed from `cortex-pty` to `miauterm-pty`; JNI symbols updated.
- ProGuard, shortcuts, and test fixtures updated to the new identity.

### Bug fixes

- Rootfs recovery flag now resets after a repair attempt, so a later missing-shell session is not skipped.
- `TerminalView` no longer fires `onSessionChanged` twice for one session switch.
- `MainActivity` holds its instance through a `WeakReference`, removing a leak path.
- Extra-keys buttons use 48dp minimum touch targets.
- Debian proot log rotation uses coreutils (`wc`, `mkfifo`, `tee`, `rm`) instead of `toybox`.
- `PtyProcess.destroy()` now reaps the child; `waitFor()` gained a timeout overload.
- `TerminalBuffer.useAlternateScreen(false)` restores the screen with a null-safe fallback.
- Recursive `start()` from the rootfs repair thread waits for the in-flight start to finish.
- `ApiServer` stops when the app has no foreground activity and the service is not running.
- `MainActivity` no longer caches a stale `SessionManager` across a version reset.

### Quality

- Unit tests and Android lint run in CI on every build.
- Arm64 APK (debug) is produced and validated with `apksigner`.

## Notes

- Because `applicationId` changed, this release installs as a new app. Existing data under the previous identity is not migrated automatically.
- No public release is published from this commit without explicit approval.
